text: After failing to save his possessed son from a demon named As'-Su' A'la, the exorcist Ustad Qodrat [returns to the village boarding school where he once studied|trigger|going back home]. The crops there have failed for three years, a girl named Jihan has been [driven by a demon to take her own life|threat|being taken over], and the boy Alif Amri, who shares his dead son's name, is possessed and attacking his mother and sister. Torn between anger and faith, Qodrat searches for [whoever has been summoning demons into the village|origin|deliberately called up].
